summary: Re-pin after a clean rebase onto d7a61301 (main after #837). Re-verified, not re-stamped: base is the current main tip, all 13 commits carry the agent marker, and the diff against the new base is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the diff reviewed and pinned at a78924d1. Substance carried forward unchanged - ACCEPT after eleven rounds. The v2 boot hold no longer releases entries before state restoration completes, and the telemetry describing that state no longer lies. The fix at this head is ONE line at bot.py:1772 - len(results) if new_symbols else len(selected) - plus two named tests, 42 insertions and 1 deletion, no scope creep. Both mutants DIE against a 145-test baseline: reverting to len(selected) emits the exact defect 'evaluated=25 confirmed=3 could_not_tell=0' and is killed by test_unreadable_exclusion_delta_counts_only_the_symbols_actually_seeded; swapping len(ineligible_exclude) for len(self._schwab_ineligible_cache) emits applied=2 where the fan-out intersection was 1 and is killed by test_unreadable_exclusion_telemetry_counts_the_fanout_intersection - that second mutant survived every previous round and is now the last one dead. Carried forward and confirmed load-bearing: all five hold-warning sites rate-limited at 1 per 25 drives with a PER-REASON key so a changed reason stays immediately visible; the three CPHI-class rationale sentences restored verbatim above an intact NOT LOAD-BEARING block; and the two-way-latch mutant, which released entries on alternate publish cycles, killed by exactly one non-vacuous repeated-cycle test. Earlier rounds established a 37-to-40 case pager matrix with zero mismatches and a real controlled pair, sh() returning UNKNOWN on raise OR non-zero exit OR empty output, safety_flag_on treating an absent variable as UNKNOWN rather than OFF, both ineligibility loaders failing closed, and the fan-out policy restored verbatim so no leg divergence is manufactured. HONESTY OF THE KILL: M1's test pins literals over a genuine partial delta rather than asserting evaluated == confirmed + could_not_tell arithmetically; the pinned triple is the reconciling one and the defect string is named in a negative assertion, so the regression is caught by construction, but a coincidentally-equal value would slip. NOT MEASURED: only the four focused files were run for the two mutants, so no full-suite check that the line-1657 change breaks nothing elsewhere; could_not_tell is never exercised non-zero in M1's killing test; and no mutant probed the still-correct empty-delta branch. ⛔ DEPLOY GATE, unchanged: rest_warmed == evaluated requires EVERY selected symbol to produce a bar within 300s and Friday's [V2-REST-WARMED] lines were 14-18 minutes apart, so restart v2 ONLY after 16:00 ET with bars still flowing, measure elapsed time to [V2-BOOT-HOLD] released, and ROLL BACK if it has not released by 20:00 ET. ⛔ A weekend restart CANNOT converge - no bars means rest_warmed can never reach evaluated - which would push the first convergence test into Monday's unattended pre-market open.
